Mauritius </h1> </div> </div> </div> </section> <div id="content" class="content full"> <div class="mt30"></div> </div> <div class="container"> <div class="row"> <div class="col-md-9"> <!-- <h2>Kitesurf Camp in Mauritius </h2> --> <div class="row"> <div class="col-md-12"> <h2 class="lead"> Our Kitesurf Camps offer the perfect package for those who want to immerse themselves in the kitesurfing experience. </h2> </div> </div> <div class="row"> <div class="col-md-12 content"> <a class="lightbox" href="/assets/img-cache/kite-camp%2C-le-morne%2C-mauritius-surf-holidays.478f67d3.jpg" title="" data-plugin-options='{"type":"image"}'> <img src="/assets/img-cache/kite-camp%2C-le-morne%2C-mauritius-surf-holidays.618c98f6.jpg" alt="" class="img-responsive pull-left mr20 mb20"> </a> <p>Our <a class="crosslink bold" href="kitesurf/" target="_blank" title="Kitesurf">Kitesurf</a> Camps we take care of your accommodation and kitesurfing lessons in one place. We are located close to the best <a class="crosslink bold" href="kitesurf/" target="_blank" title="Kitesurfing">Kitesurfing</a> beach on the island, <a class="crosslink bold" href="where-we-are-mauritius.html" target="_blank" title="Le Morne">Le Morne</a> beach, which lies in the South West of Mauritius. </p> <p>This kitesurf camp for beginners is the best solution for those who want to fully enjoy our <a class="crosslink bold" href="accommodation-mauritius/" target="_blank" title="surf house">surf house</a>, share exciting experiences and good times with new people while learning kiting with us!!! A complete package the only thing you have to do is book your tickets!!!</p> <p>In addition, we offer a wide range of additional services to make your stay even more comfortable and fun. You can rent kite equipment directly from our centre, take part in guided excursions to discover the beauty of the island, taste the local cuisine in nearby restaurants or simply relax on the beach.</p> <p>Our kitesurfing lessons are taught by qualified instructors with years of experience behind them. We can adapt to your needs and experience level, ensuring safe and effective learning. Furthermore, we only use state-of-the-art, high-quality equipment to ensure maximum safety during your kite sessions.</p> <p>Our <a class="crosslink bold" href="accommodation-mauritius/" target="_blank" title="surf house">surf house</a> is the ideal place to socialise with other kitesurfers from all over the world. You will be able to exchange tips and experiences with people who share the same passion as you and create new lasting friendships.</p> <p>Don't miss the opportunity to have an unforgettable experience in the heart of the Indian Ocean. Book your complete package at our <a class="crosslink bold" href="kitesurf/kitesurfing-school.html" target="_blank" title="kitesurf school">kitesurf school</a> in Mauritius now!</p> <p class="justifyleft"><strong>What is included our <a class="crosslink bold" href="kitesurf/" target="_blank" title="Kitesurf">Kitesurf</a> Camp:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Airport transfert roundtrip</li> <li>Accomodation in private double room</li> <li>Tranfert to the beach during the lessons</li> <li>10 hours semi private or 8 hours private lessons .</li> <li>I.K.O certificate at the end of the course</li> </ul> <p class="justifyleft"><strong>What is not icluded Kitesurf Camp:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fly ticket</li> <li>Breakfast</li> <li>Lunch/dinner</li> <li>Extra activities</li> <li>Rent equipment after the course</li> </ul> <p class="justifyleft"><strong>Price list :</strong></p> <ul> <li class="justifyleft"><strong>1 person   7    nigths : 690   euro </strong></li> <li class="justifyleft"><strong>2 persons 7    nigths : 1150   euro</strong></li> <li class="justifyleft"><strong>1 person   14  nigths : 890   euro</strong></li> <li class="justifyleft"><strong>2 persons 14  nigths : 1290 euro</strong> </li> </ul> <p>In case of no wind we will organize different activities like:  Excursions, <span class="HwtZe" lang="en"><span class="jCAhz ChMk0b"><span class="ryNqvb">dolphins</span></span></span> watching, trekking, yoga classes etc...</p> <div class="row"> <div class="col-md-12"> <hr class=""> <h3 class="mn0 center primary"><b>Photo gallery</b>
